supersedes.reason: Independent review reproduced a source/digest split-read race, line-ending and invalid-byte drift bypasses, and output-parent path escape. This manifest records the immutable-snapshot, byte-comparison, path-confinement, and actionable-I/O corrections.

checks.result: The exact review-fix commit passed all foundation commands, mandatory generated-view drift checking, 73 foundation tests, and canonical backlog validation.
The authoritative ledger and all stored evidence validated for 20 capabilities, 117 slices, 356 tasks, and 12 release gates.
The committed comprehensive plan and status summary exactly matched their canonical UTF-8 render bytes.
All six focused tests passed, including snapshot-race, CRLF, invalid-byte, junction escape, read denial, replace failure, repair, idempotency, and source-count cases.

evidence: The renderer reads planning/backlog.yaml once as bytes, parses and schema-validates that immutable payload, and derives the embedded canonical digest from the same payload; a regression attempts to swap source content after the first read and proves only one read occurs.

Check and repair modes compare raw output bytes to one canonical UTF-8 payload. CRLF conversion and invalid UTF-8 corruption are detected as drift, and regeneration restores exact canonical bytes without decoding the damaged file.

The canonical repository, backlog source, schema, output parents, and existing output files are resolved and constrained before access; a real Windows junction escape is rejected, while controlled read and atomic-replace failures return actionable diagnostics and preserve the prior destination.
Unchanged generation still performs no writes, source-derived hierarchy/status counts remain exact, and both outputs retain the explicit manual-edit prohibition.

The focused suite increased from four to six tests and now covers ordinary/manual drift, CRLF drift, invalid bytes, a source-snapshot race, repository-path redirection, read denial, replace failure cleanup, idempotency, and YAML-derived counts/statuses.
The complete foundation suite increased to 73 tests and passes at the exact review-fix commit with the mandatory backlog-view command active.
planning/README.md documents immutable snapshot hashing, exact byte comparison, repository path confinement, corrupt-byte repair, atomic replacement, and actionable I/O failure behavior.

The correction changes only the renderer, its focused tests, synchronized generated views, task audit state, and preserved initial evidence; no application, architecture, dependency, UI, or later-wave implementation scope changed.
